homepageTitle: Building the foundations of artificial superintelligence.
homepageIntroduction: GATC is an AI research and engineering company working toward recursive self-improvement and artificial superintelligence. We build systems that let AI agents pursue ambitious research, develop software, run experiments, and evaluate progress over long horizons.
futureCodeTitle: Future Code: an engineering foundation for RSI.
futureCodeIntroduction: Future Code is our agent platform for sustained research and development. It brings task coordination, persistent progress, tool execution, and evidence-based verification into one workspace. It is an important practical step in our roadmap toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) and, ultimately, artificial superintelligence (ASI).
rsiTitle: Improvement must be earned through evidence.
rsiIntroduction: Our RSI research asks how AI systems can propose improvements to their code, tools, knowledge, and research workflows, then test those proposals against fixed criteria before adopting them. The objective is a measurable improvement loop with explicit permissions, reproducible evaluations, rollback, and human oversight.
asiIntroduction: Our long-term objective is ASI: systems whose general research and problem-solving capabilities substantially exceed human capabilities. Our present work focuses on reliable agent infrastructure, scientific reasoning, experiments, memory, and evaluation. RSI and ASI remain research objectives; current Future Code versions use external model APIs and do not independently improve the underlying model weights.
